projects.title: ElderNest
projects.tagline: Empathetic, WCAG-compliant assistive web platform for elderly users.
projects.description: ElderNest is an empathetic assistive web platform designed for senior citizens. It pairs high-contrast WCAG-compliant design with peer community spaces and immediate one-tap emergency SOS assistance dispatching.

projects.title: WisdomPlay
projects.tagline: Multilingual educational Unity game with dynamic JSON-driven quizzes and audio cues.
projects.description: An interactive educational gaming environment designed to teach core curriculum concepts across multiple Indian regional languages via dynamic JSON-driven questions, 2D animation controllers, and audio cues.

projects.title: Smart Attendance System
projects.tagline: IoT/RFID automated attendance pipeline with sub-400ms scans and auto-reports.
projects.description: Hardware-to-cloud automated attendance pipeline utilizing RFID scanners, Python processing bridge, MySQL database logging, and automated CSV/Excel reports.
